info.title: Backtest Research Web API
info.description: Research backend-for-frontend. Read endpoints remain physically read-only. Data-job endpoints deliberately launch collector subprocesses with Binance network access and crypto_data write capability.

schema.title: Payload
schema.description: A fully validated deterministic backtest-run configuration.

parameters.name: deleted

schema.description: Soft-deleted runs: exclude hides them (default), only lists just them, include lists both.
schema.title: Deleted

parameters.description: Soft-deleted runs: exclude hides them (default), only lists just them, include lists both.

schema.title: Response List Data Jobs Api V1 Data Jobs Get

post.description: Launches a collector subprocess with external Binance network access and crypto_data write capability after validation. Half-open [start, end) ranges longer than 2000 days are rejected.

delete.description: Hide one run from the default listing without deleting anything stored.

Remove one run, its cascaded rows, and its Evidence file for good.

This cannot be undone. The Evidence artifact goes first: if the catalog row
then fails to disappear, the run stays visible with its Evidence missing,
which the reader can see and retry, rather than leaving an orphaned file
nothing points at.

post.description: Clear the soft-delete marker so the run is listed again.
